title: The Iron Oath Program
author: Diego M.
desc:
To push beyond mediocrity. Optimizing full body development with a strong focus on the upper body. Each workout specifically designed, each muscle group being targeted atleast 2x per week; no fluff included. 

Push yourself & reap the rewards of the Iron Oath Program. The only thing between you & your dream physique is consistency & hard work. Stay hard & watch your dreams transform into reality!
